slides: Trust is a payment schedule.
The people you work with watch what you do, not what you say. Swipe.
Pay when you said you would.
Reliable payment buys you reliable people. Late payment buys you excuses and the back of the line.
Be clear before the work starts.
Scope, timing, who decides. Most conflicts are an expectation nobody wrote down.
Good partners are built slowly.
Be fair when it's inconvenient. That's the habit people remember and the one that brings them back.
caption:
Trust is a payment schedule.

The people you work with watch what you do, not what you say.

Pay when you said you would. Be clear before the work starts. Be fair when it's inconvenient.

Reliable partners are built slowly, and lost fast.

What's one habit that earns trust in your business? 👇

topic: mental load of the COO seat
slides: Nobody sees the list that runs in your head at night.
Running operations means carrying everyone's problems at once. Naming the load is how you start to manage it.
caption:
Nobody sees the list that runs in your head at night.

Running operations means carrying a lot of moving parts at once. Pretending it's light doesn't make it lighter.

Get it out of your head and onto paper. Then decide what's yours to carry.

How do you put the day down at night? 👇

#operations #leadership #mentalload #businessowner #management #realtalk

slides: Every mistake sends an invoice.
Make sure you collect the lesson you paid for. Swipe.
Fix the cause, not the symptom.
Blaming a person feels fast. Asking why the system allowed it is what stops the repeat.
Write the lesson down.
A mistake you only remember in your gut returns. One written line becomes a checklist item.
Make it safe to report early.
Teams hide small errors when speaking up is punished. Reward early reports and big failures get rarer.
caption:
Every mistake sends an invoice.

The only question is whether you also collect the lesson.

Fix the cause, not the symptom. Write the lesson down. Make it safe to report problems early.

Small errors caught early are the cheapest education there is.

What lesson did a mistake teach you that nothing else could? 👇

#operations #lessonslearned #leadership #businessowner #systems #management

slides: Waiting for perfect information is also a decision.
Make the call with what you know, set a point to review it, and adjust.
caption:
Waiting for perfect information is also a decision.

Under pressure, the cost of delay is real, even when nobody sees it.

Make the call with what you know. Set a date to review it. Adjust.

How do you decide when you only have most of the facts? 👇
